name: Spokeo
source: Flow and selectors from Blake104/OptOut (AGPL-3.0) spokeo.yml, verified upstream 2026-05-10; process matches BADBOOL's Spokeo entry.
notes: Needs the address of the person's own Spokeo listing (Discovery → Find your listings). Spokeo shows a reCAPTCHA checkbox: with a CAPTCHA solver plugin the flow finishes itself, otherwise it waits in the CAPTCHA queue. Spokeo then emails a confirmation link to the one-time address, which OpenOptOut clicks. Links expire within about a day. FreePeopleDirectory listings are removed through this same page. Spokeo may keep data for paid accounts even after it disappears from free search.
